rationale: Builds directly on the current reverse-tail recurrent baseline and spends a small amount of remaining artifact budget on a tensor family that local runs keep pointing at: recurrent-tail value projections. The change is compact, compile-stable, and optimizes the exact scored path by keeping `attn.c_v` weights in fp16 across all recurrent-tail blocks instead of only the very last one.
title: Recurrent-Tail V FP16 Export Rescue
